prompt: Create an original 90 second melodic breakbeat electronica instrumental composition for science explainer, tutorial and educational narration. Mood: curious, clear, thoughtful. Instruments: breakbeat drums, rounded bass, shimmering synth. Style: syncopated chopped drum rhythm under an evolving melody. Tempo approximately 132 BPM; G major. Main idea: an ascending fourth answered by a stepwise descent. Keep the lead sparse and the midrange uncluttered for spoken narration. Instrumental only. No vocals, no choir, no humming, no singing, no speech, no lyrics, no vocal samples. Do not imitate any existing artist or melody. [00:00-00:30] Establish the main idea immediately with the core ensemble. [00:30-01:00] Develop the motif with a complementary instrumental counterline, preserving the intended energy. [01:00-01:30] Return to the main idea and give a musically resolved ending with a short natural tail. Finish around 01:30.
